coverage_override.reason: The final each-effect HOPT sentence is represented with the three activated effects it limits; the Xyz material condition is separately recorded.

effects.lua_implementation: AddXyzProcedure requires at least two Level 2 Shining Brigade materials.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Xyz procedure with a fixed Level and minimum material count.

effects.printed_clause: If a "Shining Brigade" card you control leaves the field because of your opponent's card: You can Special Summon this card from your GY, then inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the monster your opponent controls with the highest ATK.
effects.lua_implementation: EVENT_LEAVE_FIELD now tests previous controller and previous archetype without an unprinted face-up requirement, requires opponent battle/effect responsibility, then revives this card and damages by the highest current face-up opposing ATK.

official_references.matched_structure: Official leave-field-by-opponent trigger checks previous controller and opponent effect responsibility without requiring the departed card to have been face-up.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: IsPreviousPosition(POS_FACEUP) excluded Set Shining Brigade cards even though the printed trigger says any Shining Brigade card you control.

effects.printed_clause: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Attach 1 "Shining Brigade" card from your Deck to this card as material.
effects.lua_implementation: A mandatory controller-Standby trigger selects one archetype card from the Deck and overlays it, with its own HOPT code.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Xyz-material handling uses Duel.Overlay and material-related legality structures.

effects.printed_clause: You can detach 2 materials from this card: Double the ATK/DEF of all "Shining Brigade" monsters you control until the End Phase. You can only use each effect of "Shining Brigade - Revenge Division" once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The Ignition Effect detaches exactly two materials as cost and sets each face-up controlled archetype monster's final ATK/DEF to twice its current values until the End Phase, under a distinct HOPT code.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Xyz effect removes overlay material as an activation cost.
Official temporary effects use an End Phase reset.
